# Signal Weekly — Nov 9–Nov 16, 2026

*Nov 9–Nov 16, 2026*

This week’s tech roundup mixes fresh AI moves, Apple tweaks, and some cool new hardware and research. From AI‑powered tables to portable gamepads, there’s something for every curious reader.

## Tech news

- **[Databricks pitches AI that predicts from tables without training](https://thenextweb.com/news/databricks-tabular-foundation-models-ai-runtime-guide)** (The Next Web) — Databricks unveils GPU‑accelerated table‑based AI that promises faster, cost‑variable predictions.
- **[Apple adds ‘face unlock’ to the iPhone Duo, but it’s not Face ID](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/16/apple-adds-face-unlock-to-the-iphone-duo-but-its-not-face-id/)** (TechCrunch) — Apple’s new face‑unlock on the Duo offers fresh privacy considerations for users.
- **[California Sues OpenAI Over Hugging Face Attack, Other Cybersecurity Incidents](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/california-sues-openai-hugging-face-attack-cybersecurity-incidents)** (The Information) — California’s lawsuit highlights legal risks for AI firms and the open‑source ecosystem.

## AI papers

- **[FETTUCCINE: Fast and efficient brain-to-text decoding on mobile devices](http://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18561v1)** (Jonathan D. McCart, Pranav I. Deevi et al.) — FETTUCCINE delivers low‑resource brain‑to‑text decoding for everyday mobile devices.

## Reviews

- **[This tiny gamepad with dual analog thumbsticks pushes the limits of portable controllers](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1013985/crkd-atom-plus-tmr-analog-thumbstick-controller-gamepad-switch-ios-android-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — The tiny CRKD Atom Plus gamepad redefines portable control with dual analog thumbsticks.
- **[Claude’s Duet agent is a little neurotic and surprisingly helpful](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1032518/claude-duet-ai-agent-hands-on)** (The Verge Reviews) — Claude’s Duet agent shows how a neurotic but helpful AI can streamline content creation.

---

Thanks for reading—stay curious and keep exploring the tech frontier!
thread: 🚀 Databricks just rolled out AI that predicts from tables—no training needed. Imagine instant insights on any dataset!
👀 Apple’s new face‑unlock on the iPhone Duo isn’t Face ID, but it adds a fresh layer of convenience and privacy questions.
⚖️ California sues OpenAI over a Hugging Face attack—highlighting the growing legal tightrope for AI and open‑source tools.
🧠 FETTUCCINE brings brain‑to‑text decoding to your phone, making real‑time neural communication a reality on everyday hardware.
🎮 The CRKD Atom Plus gamepad shrinks the controller world—dual analog sticks in a palm‑sized package for gamers on the go.
🤖 Claude’s Duet agent is a bit neurotic, yet surprisingly handy for non‑dev creators—think of it as your new content sidekick.
